de: Decrease in testosterone with age is a natural process, believes the andrologist, founder of the center for the treatment of male infertility Elena Novikova. According to her, the level of the hormone also affects physical activity, body weight…

de: British actress Bonnie Wright, best known for her role as Ginny Weasley in the Harry Potter film series, became a mother for the second time. The 35-year-old actress and her wife Andrew Lokoko had a son, who was named Astaire Skye. Good news…

t: Из сейфа убитой москвички похитили не менее $14,6 тысячи — по делу проходят восемь человек
d: Не менее 14,6 тысячи долларов похитили из сейфа участники преступной схемы, связанной с убийством женщины на западе Москвы. Об этом председатель Следственного комитета России Александр Бастрыкин рассказал в интервью РИА «Новости».
te: From the safe of the killed Muscovite stole at least $14.6 thousand — in the case are eight people
de: At least 14.6 thousand dollars were stolen from the safe participants of a criminal scheme related to the murder of a woman in the west of Moscow. Chairman of the Investigative Committee of Russia Alexander Bastrykin said in an interview with RIA Novosti.

t: Офицер ВС РФ сообщил о брошенных без связи группах ВСУ в Доброполье
d: Украинское командование при отступлении из Доброполья в ДНР оставило разрозненные группы военнослужащих без связи и поддержки. Об этом РИА «Новости» рассказал офицер 110-го полка 51-й армии группировки войск «Центр» с позывным Шахтёр.
te: The officer of the Russian Armed Forces reported about the abandoned without communication groups of the APU in Dobropolye
de: The Ukrainian command, when retreating from Dobropol to the DPR, left scattered groups of servicemen without communication and support. About this RIA "Novosti" told the officer of the 110th regiment of the 51st army grouping of troops "Center" with the call sign Shakhtar.

te: Camera turned away: Leipzig Airport “overlooked” the ramming of the fence at the parking lot of Russian An-124
de: The surveillance camera at the German Leipzig/Halle airport did not record the moment of damage to the protective fence in the area of the parking lot of Russian cargo planes. This is reported by Bild with reference to representatives of the police and the air harbor.

te: Pop MMA fighter Nikarkho was in intensive care after a fight with a shooting in Vladikavkaz
de: In Vladikavkaz there was a night quarrel between young people, one of the participants in the conflict took out a traumatic pistol and opened fire. Two people were injured. About the incident reports the interior Ministry for North Ossetia.

te: At the airport of Irkutsk at the An-24 broke the wheel during landing
de: At the airport of Irkutsk at the aircraft An-24 airlines "IrAero" during landing burst the wheel of the right landing gear, after which the crew reported smoke. This was reported by the press service of the East Siberian Transport Prosecutor's Office.

t: «Зенит» обыграл «Ахмат» со счётом 3:2 и возглавил турнирную таблицу РПЛ

te: Zenit beat Akhmat with a score of 3: 2 and headed the RPL standings
de: Petersburg “Zenit” won a strong-willed victory over Grozny “Akhmat” in the 11th round of the Russian Premier League. The meeting at Gazprom Arena ended with a score of 3: 2, and the hosts scored the decisive ball in the last minute of normal time.

t: «Гладкие, но пустые»: Россиян предупредили о главных ошибках на собеседовании
d: Заучивание идеальных ответов — самая частая ошибка на собеседовании, рассказала аналитик Карина Остроносова. По её словам, работодателю важно понять ход мыслей кандидата и убедиться, что его слова подкреплены реальным опытом.
te: “Smooth but empty”: Russians warned about the main mistakes in the interview
de: Memorizing the perfect answers is the most common mistake in an interview, said analyst Karina Ostronosova. According to her, it is important for the employer to understand the candidate’s thoughts and make sure that his words are supported by real experience.

t: Во Франции после массовых беспорядков задержали более 2 тысяч человек
d: Число задержанных после массовых беспорядков во Франции 17 октября превысило две тысячи человек, а более 600 полицейских, жандармов и пожарных получили травмы. Об этом сообщил министр внутренних дел страны Лоран Нуньес в социальной сети X.
te: In France after the riots detained more than 2 thousand people
de: The number of detainees after the riots in France on October 17 exceeded two thousand people, and more than 600 police, gendarmes and firefighters were injured. This was announced by the Minister of internal Affairs of the country Laurent Nunez in the social network X.

t: Турция хочет «погреть руки» на дизельной сделке России и США
d: Турция рассчитывает получить часть российского дизельного топлива, поставки которого предусмотрены договорённостями Москвы и Вашингтона. Об этом министр энергетики и природных ресурсов страны Алпарслан Байрактар сообщил в эфире Kanal 7.
te: Turkey wants to “warm hands” on the diesel deal between Russia and the United States
de: Turkey expects to receive part of the Russian diesel fuel, the supply of which is provided for by agreements between Moscow and Washington. The Minister of Energy and Natural Resources of the country Alparslan Bayraktar said on the air of Kanal 7.

d: Во Франции могут попытаться не допустить Марин Ле Пен до президентских выборов 2027 года либо оспорить результаты голосования, если она в итоге займёт первое место. Такой сценарий допустил сенатор Алексей Пушков в своём Telegram-канале.
te: Romanian scenario for Paris: Pushkov told how Le Pen will prevent to oust Macron
de: France may try to keep Marine Le Pen out of the 2027 presidential election or challenge the results of the vote if she eventually wins first place. This scenario was allowed by Senator Alexei Pushkov in his Telegram channel.

de: The exemptions for Russian diesel fuel do not mean the lifting of restrictions on oil from Russia. U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in an interview with CNN.

te: Lokomotiv hockey player Artem Kuzin made an offer to Elizaveta Nugumanova
de: Former Russian figure skater Elizaveta Nugumanova is getting married. The offer of a hand and heart to the athlete was made by her lover - hockey player of the Yaroslavl Lokomotiv Artem Kuzin.

t: Дания отказалась от соглашения с Россией по безопасности на море
d: Дания не поддержала предложение России заключить соглашение о предотвращении опасных инцидентов в открытом море и воздушном пространстве. Об этом сообщили в российском посольстве в Копенгагене.
te: Denmark refuses agreement with Russia on maritime safety
de: Denmark did not support Russia’s proposal to conclude an agreement on the prevention of dangerous incidents on the high seas and airspace. This was reported in the Russian Embassy in Copenhagen.

t: Школьница из Пензы посадила трёх парней за изнасилование, а их семьи пытались наказать её

de: In Penza, three young people received sentences ranging from 3.5 to 10 years in prison in the case of rape of a minor. Relatives of the convicts do not agree with the sentences and claim that violations were committed in the investigation.
